in_marathi.name: Ronav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ronav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ronav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rona' which means joyful and 'V' which stands for victory. This name is a perfect blend of happiness and triumph.
